verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter or bitrate, and shows no dashboard or metrics API for debugging sessions. Telemetry channels over the relays are a developer building block for carrying app data, not built-in session diagnostics. Observability is a fair axis for a media relay, so the absence of evidence makes this none, not na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls
